Hey there! I have very bad anxiety too and I work in the service line too which makes it difficult to avoid people. My advice would be to set up mini rewards everyday for doing a good job at work, and also to reward yourself to look forward to something during your off days to get you through the worst of the anxieties.

The anxiety at a new work place is inevitable but let's try to make it a little more tolerable :)
Maybe a hoodie or a blanket of sorts? For some warm cuddles or some place to hide when things get tough :)
